title: Sun Charts
description: Online solar chart creator. A tool that can be used to create sun elevation charts for your location.

components.content:
# Sun Charts

Online solar chart creator for calculating sun elevation charts based on your location.

## Features
- Create sun elevation charts for any location
- Visualize solar angles throughout the day
- Plan solar installations and shading analysis

## Reference
[Solar Chart Program - University of Oregon](http://solardat.uoregon.edu/SunChartProgram.html)
